voice_tts_library.description: Voice/TTS model dependency catalog for TeamManager/DRE-Go. Entries are mirrored locally under /opt/ai-box/models/voice-tts-library and intended to be promoted to Forgejo release assets or installer snapshot downloads before public distribution.
voice_tts_library.installer_note: Do not treat these entries as single-file assets until archive/release assets are created. Installer support should consume this section as repository snapshots or generated bundle assets.
